No entry offer

Listeners leave without a trace

Someone who finishes a podcast episode or your TEDx talk and isn’t ready for 1-on-1 has nothing to join today, so you can’t follow up with them.

Your time is the filter

Every curious person gets 20 minutes

The free consultation is open to anyone who books it. You review every answer yourself, so qualifying leads costs your own calendar instead of happening before it.

Nothing in between

The method only exists 1-on-1

Extreme Preparation is a system people can learn, but today the only way to get it is a coaching engagement. The book isn’t out yet, so there is no smaller first yes.

Anyone who isn’t ready for 1-on-1 coaching today leaves with nothing, and you have no way to reach them again.

A free Extreme Preparation masterclass between your content and your calls

Meet Randall

Hi, I’m Randall Kaplan

I’m an executive coach and a co-founder of Akamai Technologies. In 1999 I founded JUMP Investors, and I’ve made more than 100 investments since.

At 24 I moved to Los Angeles and wrote 300 cold letters to CEOs. Everyone told me I was crazy and that nobody would meet with me. I got 80 meetings. That became the start of Extreme Preparation®, the system I’ve used for 25+ years of advising founders, executives and professional athletes.

From
Randall Kaplan
Subject
The partnership he didn’t sign
Preview
A dentist, a 50/50 deal, and the decision we made first.

Hi [first name],

Cristian is a pediatric dentist. He found me through my podcast and messaged me on Instagram. He told me later, “I was a fairly successful dentist… but I was unsettled and wanted more.”

When we started, he was about to open a new practice with a 50/50 partner. Before anything else, we prepared for that decision. He went ahead as the sole owner, and we built the plan around the location, the lease, the financing and the cash flow.

His words: “Going into business with that partner would have been a disaster.”

That’s Extreme Preparation in practice: the biggest wins often come from the mistakes you avoid. If you have a decision like that in front of you, let’s talk.

Apply for a call

Randall
